About the Role
At HI FIVE Community Services, we believe support should feel personal, not just professional. We’re a close-knit team that genuinely cares about the people we work with, and we’re committed to helping individuals living with disabilities live life on their own terms with dignity, choice, and independence.
For us, it’s not just about providing services; it’s about building real relationships. We take the time to understand each participant their goals, their routines, and what matters most to them. Whether it’s supporting everyday activities, building confidence, or encouraging community participation, we stand beside our participants every step of the way.
Our approach is simple: treat people with respect, show up with compassion, and do the little things that make a big difference. At HI FIVE, we aim to create a warm and supportive environment where participants feel valued and our team feels proud of the impact they make every day.
Because at the heart of what we do is one belief everyone deserves the opportunity to live a full and meaningful life.

We are a well-established and reputable Chinese restaurant in New South Wales, committed to providing authentic Chinese cuisine and exceptional customer service. We are seeking an experienced and motivated Restaurant Manager to lead our operations, manage our team, and ensure the continued success and growth of our business.
This is a permanent full-time management position offering an excellent opportunity for an experienced hospitality professional to oversee all aspects of restaurant operations while maintaining high standards of food quality, customer service and operational efficiency.

Roles and Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following duties:

•	Manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of the restaurant to ensure efficient, safe and profitable business performance.
•	Coordinate and supervise restaurant operations across dine-in, takeaway, catering and online delivery services to ensure high standards of food quality and customer service.
•	Work closely with the Head Chef to develop, review and update menus, including seasonal menus, promotional items and special event offerings.
•	Establish, review and adjust menu pricing across all service channels, including dine-in, takeaway, catering and online delivery platforms such as Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Panda, taking into consideration food costs, competitor pricing and business profitability.
•	Plan, coordinate and manage catering services, private functions, corporate events, birthday celebrations and other special occasions to ensure smooth service delivery and customer satisfaction.
•	Monitor inventory levels of fresh produce, seafood, beverages, dry goods, packaging materials, cleaning supplies and other restaurant consumables to minimise waste and maintain efficient stock control.
•	Coordinate purchasing schedules, source suppliers and negotiate pricing and supply arrangements to ensure quality products are obtained at competitive prices.
•	Monitor restaurant sales, labour costs, food costs and other operating expenses, analyse financial and operational reports, and implement strategies to improve revenue, productivity and profitability.
•	Prepare staff rosters and allocate duties according to business requirements while maintaining efficient staffing levels.
•	Recruit, interview, induct, train, supervise and evaluate front-of-house and kitchen staff to ensure employees understand and comply with operational procedures and customer service standards.
•	Conduct staff performance reviews and provide coaching, mentoring and ongoing professional development to improve employee performance and operational effectiveness.
•	Manage customer reservations, coordinate seating arrangements and supervise service during busy trading periods.
•	Review and respond to customer feedback received both in-store and through online delivery platforms, investigate complaints promptly and implement appropriate corrective actions to improve customer satisfaction.
•	Ensure compliance with all applicable Food Safety Standards, Work Health and Safety (WHS) legislation, liquor licensing requirements and company policies and procedures.
•	Maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety, workplace safety and presentation throughout the restaurant.
•	Liaise with senior management to identify opportunities for continuous improvement, increased operational efficiency and business growth.

Skills and Experience
Applicants should possess:

•	An AQF Diploma, Advanced Diploma or higher qualification in Hospitality Management, Restaurant Management or a related discipline; or equivalent qualifications recognised in Australia.
•	At least three years of relevant full-time experience as a Restaurant Manager or in a comparable management role within the hospitality industry.
